description: This file defines classes for dispatching and observing POSIX signals within the 'ocudu' namespace, including signal_dispatcher and signal_observer, with methods for attaching, detaching, and handling signals.

classes.name: signal_dispatcher
classes.description: A class that manages attaching, detaching, and notifying observers of POSIX signals.

classes.name: signal_observer
classes.description: An observer class that subscribes to a signal_dispatcher and executes a callback upon signal reception.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Adds a signal_observer to the dispatcher's list of observers.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Removes a signal_observer from the dispatcher's list of observers.

methods.name: notify_signal
methods.description: Calls handle_signal on all attached observers with the given signal.

methods.name: signal_observer
methods.description: Constructor that attaches the observer to a dispatcher and sets the callback.

methods.name: ~signal_observer
methods.description: Destructor that automatically detaches the observer from the dispatcher.

methods.name: handle_signal
methods.description: Invokes the callback when a signal is received.
